## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` pass

- [ ] Public API / schema changes recorded in CHANGELOG.md (`tests/api-surface.test.ts` updated)
- [ ] Docs updated; features labeled IMPLEMENTED / EXPERIMENTAL / PLANNED honestly
- [ ] No customer data, credentials, or redistribution-restricted datasets
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO 1.1; see CONTRIBUTING.md)
